mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units indicate strong residential demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100k indicates tight labor markets that boost consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index above 110 (base 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
